evals.name: general-sluggish-low-fps
evals.prompt: The communicator prop UI feels really sluggish — I'm only getting about 10-20 fps and the frame times are all over the place. Review the firmware in firmware/communicator and figure out what's killing the display framerate. Consistent frame times matter most to me, then higher fps. Give me a prioritized list of what to fix.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized, impact-ranked review report with concrete file:line findings. Leads with consistency fixes (core affinity / contention), then throughput (hybrid allocator, redraw area, per-frame widget churn). Does NOT recommend known dead ends (dropping refresh period, raising CPU clock) or constraint-violating fixes (builtin pool, swap_bytes). Includes a measurement plan using the FPS HUD / prop.py.

evals.name: spectrum-screen-crawls
evals.prompt: When I open the spectrum analyzer screen on the prop it drops to a crawl and the bars stutter, but the static home screen runs fine. What's going on, and how do I make the spectrum screen smooth?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the per-frame widget churn on the spectrum screen (32 bars x ~3 LVGL ops every frame in ui_observer) AND the PSRAM draw-mask allocation penalty (the documented ~8 fps vs ~18 static cause). Recommends the hybrid allocator and shadow-compare/throttle for the bars. Cites file:line. Avoids generic advice.

evals.name: laggy-input-periodic-hitch
evals.prompt: The dial/touch input on the communicator feels laggy and the animation hitches roughly once a second. I want buttery-smooth, consistent frame times. Profile this and tell me what to change, ranked by impact.
evals.expected_output: Prioritizes consistency: core affinity (LVGL vs radio tasks all unpinned), lock contention / work under the LVGL lock, and periodic full-rebuilds (BLE list lv_obj_clean every ~400ms). Connects input latency to the LVGL lock. Ranked by impact with file:line and a before/after measurement plan. Doesn't just chase average fps.
